definitions: Exploding or causing something to explode.
Inflating something with air or gas.
Becoming very angry or losing one's temper.
Making something seem much more important or serious than it really is.
examples: The engineers are blowing up the old building.
He is blowing up the balloons for the party.
She is blowing up at her colleagues again.
The media is blowing up the minor incident.
They are blowing up the picture to poster size.
